Local Effect: Safety switch does not actuate on demand
System Effect: Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
Detection Method: SIL proof-test; PFDavg calculation
Recommended Action: Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

System Effect: Nuisance shutdown
Detection Method: Trip log review; instrument calibration check
Recommended Action: Re-calibrate set-point; check for vibration or contamination

Local Effect: ESD valve does not close on demand
System Effect: Safety function unavailable — process hazard propagates
Detection Method: Partial stroke test (PST); SIL proof-test schedule
Recommended Action: Immediate proof-test; check coil continuity and air supply

System Effect: Nuisance shutdown — production loss
Detection Method: Spurious trip log; review MTTR
Recommended Action: Check for voltage spike / EMI on coil; review wiring

System Effect: Uncontrolled flow — possible flooding or overpressure downstream
Detection Method: Positioner feedback deviation alarm
Recommended Action: Switch to manual bypass; inspect actuator diaphragm, positioner

System Effect: Flow stoppage — process starvation, pump dead-heading
Detection Method: Low flow alarm (FIA-L); pump trip on low-flow protection
Recommended Action: Check air supply pressure; inspect positioner; replace actuator

System Effect: Loss of control — process drifts from setpoint
Detection Method: Controller output deviation alarm
Recommended Action: Check valve positioner signal; inspect packing / gland

System Effect: Fugitive emission — HSE hazard if toxic/flammable
Detection Method: Periodic leak check per API 624; FID / gas detector
Recommended Action: Tighten packing; replace stem packing at next shutdown

Recommended Action: Activate ESD; verify PSV lift; investigate cause after isolation

System Effect: Flooding downstream equipment; pump cavitation
Detection Method: LSH alarm; LHH trip
Recommended Action: Activate level shutdown; divert flow; inspect level instrument

System Effect: Pump cavitation; loss of process
Detection Method: LSL alarm; LLL trip
Recommended Action: Reduce outflow; check inlet isolation valves

System Effect: Process fluid contaminates utility stream (or vice versa)
Detection Method: Conductivity analyser on cooling water return; AT alarm
Recommended Action: Isolate and plug affected tubes; schedule re-tube at shutdown

System Effect: Reduced heat transfer — temperature drift
Detection Method: TI outlet temperature trending; increasing DP
Recommended Action: Chemical clean or mechanical descale per maintenance schedule

System Effect: Loss of head, impeller damage, vibration
Detection Method: VT-101 vibration transmitter; FIA-L low-flow alarm
Recommended Action: Increase suction pressure; check NPSH; reduce speed

System Effect: Process fluid loss — HSE/environmental hazard
Detection Method: Seal pot level alarm; shaft leak detector
Recommended Action: Switch to standby pump; schedule seal replacement
